newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Grocorp slips to estimated half-yr loss.
newsitem.headline: Grocorp slips to estimated half-yr loss.

text.p: Note - Grocorp Pacific Ltd is an apple growing company.
The company said that at this stage of the season the final returns from the company's apple operations were not known.
"Accordingly, the half year result incorporates a best estimate based on the market indicator rates provided by the NZ Apple & Pear Marketing Board.

"Similarly, the final results from trading activities (other than apples) are not known at this stage with certainty. Nor are the final costs of closing down these activities in accordance with the decision already communicated to shareholders.
"Notwithstanding the profitability of the apple operations, the likely company result is anticipated to be a loss in the order of $1-2 milllion for the 13 month period to October 31."
